_note: OSO approvals and admin overrides. Covers three requirements from the doc: 'Ability to note approval for a repo to avoid continuing notification', 'Ability to unblock use of licenses for individual repos', and 'Allows to be overridden by admin'.

_fields.repo: owner/name, or a trailing-* prefix, or * for org-wide
_fields.license: OSO license name as it appears in license-matrix.json, or * for any
_fields.package: package name, or * for any (optional, defaults to *)
_fields.tier: tier to force for matching findings: green (silences it) or yellow (downgrades red to a notification)
_fields.approved_by: who granted it -- required, appears in the report
_fields.ticket: OSO/Jira reference for the approval -- required, appears in the report
_fields.expires: YYYY-MM-DD. Expired approvals are ignored and reported as expired.
_fields.note: free text shown in the report

approvals.note: Example entry. Build-time only, not linked into the shipped artifact.
